about: The Suno account's credits, read from Suno (account-usage) by suno.b. Song credits pay for generations (10 per generation of two takes, measured); download credits pay for full-quality downloads (1 each). Updated each time suno.b spends.

log.asked_by: Dinis: "Can we try to write a song?"
Dinis: a Brazilian instrumental with strong melodic lines and stops

log.what: Parada, version 2 (slower, Brazilian jazz), built on version 1 take A
log.asked_by: Dinis: a slower variation, keep the batucada and the melodic line, Brazilian jazz

log.what: Devagar, version 1 (new slow Brazilian jazz instrumental)
log.asked_by: Dinis: a new Brazilian song, much slower, a completely new melody

log.what: Contratempo, version 1 (syncopated Brazilian jazz, section map)
log.asked_by: Dinis: a bit faster, much more syncopated, breaks, unison, call and response, a drum solo

log.what: Contratempo, em fado and Luz de Fado (two generations, built on Contratempo take B and Luz de Tarde take A)
log.asked_by: Dinis: the last two as Portuguese fado guitar versions
Dinis: one more with an extreme funk feel, still with the Portuguese guitar

log.what: Contratempo, em fado, version 2 (a little funkier, all acoustic)
log.asked_by: Dinis: less funk drums, no electric guitar, a bit more funky within the earlier style

log.what: Contratempo, em fado, version 3 (halfway to funk)
log.asked_by: Dinis: a bit more funky in the earlier style; use all the credits

log.what: Contratempo, em fado, version 4 (from scratch, acoustic fado-funk)
log.asked_by: Dinis: a bit more funky in the earlier style; use all the credits

log.what: Contratempo, em fado v5 and Guitarra e Cavaquinho v1 (two generations)
log.asked_by: Dinis: the redo with the Brazilian groove, and the first fado-guitar experiment

log.what: Guitarra e Cavaquinho, version 2 (Algarve corridinho accordion)
log.asked_by: Dinis: the same, plus an accordion in the corridinho style

log.what: Guitarra em Bossa, version 1 (experiment 2: bossa nova rhythm section)
log.asked_by: Dinis: "can we create a new song?" (read as a request to make one; the queue's next line)

log.what: Guitarra e Cavaquinho, version 3 (Branco de Alentejo, acoustic and rock and roll in turn)
log.asked_by: Dinis: Branco de Alentejo with its A and B sections alternating normal and rock and roll

log.what: Guitarra e Cavaquinho, version 4 (Branco de Alentejo take B, acoustic and rock and roll in turn)
log.asked_by: Dinis: redo it from take B, the version he liked

log.what: Block 1: The Hand-Over Patter and Take B, each with lyrics and instrumental (four generations)
log.asked_by: Dinis: four songs per block, witty lyrics, surprising styles

limit_note: No working limit: Dinis, 25 Nov, "the point here is to use all the credits". Downloads only for takes picked for release.
